thread:
Sofia Li: quick flag: concat-augment (v1) was included in today's int4 canary for qx6b and we saw a spike in ordering/early-stop diffs vs fp16 baseline.

Sofia Li: summary snippet: 
```nrun: qx6b-int4-175060
examples_total: 980
mismatch_rate: 0.044
primary_signals: [ordering, early_stop, punctuation_shift]
```

Diego Ramos: is concat-augment the same pipeline we used for synth-joins last month or the new suffix-trim flow?

Sofia Li: it's the new suffix-trim flow (concat-augment v1.2) that appends examples and then trims a trailing "\n". Might be interacting with tokenizer tail heuristics.

Nina Shah: can you paste 2 sanitized failure samples? also check if any are duplicate to golden set (de-dup collision).

Sofia Li: pasted sanitized samples: 
- "Prompt: compare prices || appended example with trailing space" -> model drops last list item post-quant
- "System: policy A || user example -> appended QA pair" -> output rearranged bullet order

Owen Park: my hunch is kvcache index drift when we remove suffix tokens during batching. We merged a kernel selection heuristic last week (runtime PR #913) that tweaks attention offsets for trimmed prefixes.

qbench-bot: [qbench] run=qx6b-int4-175060 baseline=qx6b-fp16-175000 delta_mismatch=+4.4% ci=[+2.8%,+6.0%] top_signals=[ordering,early_stop,token_trim]. details: https://qbench.local/runs/qx6b-int4-175060

Diego Ramos: proposed plan: (A) rerun canary with concat-augment excluded to see if dataset augmentation is root cause, (B) run int4 with `--kernelset=legacy-2025-12` and `--kvcache-trace=on` for 10 failing ids, (C) build a micro-golden of 200 examples that mirrors concat-augment edgecases.

Nina Shah: I'll own (C). I'll create micro-golden set and also run a fast de-dup check against main golden to ensure no overlap. ETA ~4h.

Owen Park: I'll do (B) and collect KV dumps for 8 failing seeds. I'll drop them into `s3://redwood-dev/qbench/kvdumps/qx6b-175060/` and attach sample-stamps.

Sofia Li: I'll kick off (A) now and post updated qbench link. Muting concat-augment from baseline for this run.

Diego Ramos: add `sample-stamp` to all failing ids (format: <run>-<seed>-<ts>) and include first-256 tokens of KV for easy diffs. Also open ticket INF-1735 and tag runtime/quant.

qbench-bot: [task] created INF-1735: "qx6b-int4: concat-augment ordering/early-stop triage" assigned to runtime+curation.

Sofia Li: thanks team. I'll upload initial canary diffs and the micro-golden link when ready. :thumbsup:
